title: How to control your OpenAI Price with Service tiers

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and TCI video on an OpenAI specific topic, which is their service tiers.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 影片要介紹 OpenAI 專屬的 Service Tier。

cues.en: So, again, this is OpenAI specific, because they have something called Flex Standard and Priority,
cues.zh: 再次提醒，這是 OpenAI 的功能，包含 Flex、Standard 與 Priority，

cues.en: where you can choose your speed versus your pricing.
cues.zh: 讓你在速度與價格之間選擇。

cues.en: Azure OpenAI doesn't have the same, or they have something, but it's an invite only, so we will leave it out of this video.
cues.zh: Azure OpenAI 沒有完全相同的機制，或說有類似但需受邀使用的功能，所以這裡先不討論。

cues.en: So, this is for OpenAI specific.
cues.zh: 這次只針對 OpenAI。

cues.en: So, if you go to the pricing model of OpenAI, you can see there's something called Batch.
cues.zh: 到 OpenAI 的價格頁面，可以看到 Batch。

cues.en: We have a separate video for that, but there's Flex, Standard, and Priority.
cues.zh: Batch 有另一支影片介紹；這裡看 Flex、Standard 與 Priority。

cues.en: Standard is what you normally always see, and we see the different input and output pricing,
cues.zh: Standard 就是一般常見的輸入與輸出價格，

cues.en: while Priority has been there for a while and is double the price.
cues.zh: Priority 已經推出一段時間，價格大約是兩倍。

cues.en: For the double the price, you get less errors, less timeouts, and faster latency in general.
cues.zh: 多付費可以得到較少錯誤與逾時，以及整體較低的延遲。

cues.en: A new thing they have is Flex, which goes the other way, which is slower and more latency,
cues.zh: 新加入的 Flex 則相反，速度較慢、延遲較高，

cues.en: but if you can manage that, you get it for half the price, meaning the same as the batch prices.
cues.zh: 但如果能接受，價格只有一半，也就是與 Batch 相同的折扣。

cues.en: So, these are the three options, and the way you control it is either one of two ways.
cues.zh: 這是三種選項，可以透過兩種方式控制。

cues.en: One way is that every API key you have is linked to what is called a project,
cues.zh: 第一種是每組 API 金鑰都會關聯到一個 Project，

cues.en: and in projects, you can go in and set if it should run Default or Priority.
cues.zh: 到專案設定中，可以選擇 Default 或 Priority。

cues.en: It cannot run Flex at the moment, but you simply just switch to Priority, and then you're paying double the price now with better performance,
cues.zh: 目前專案預設不能選 Flex；直接切換成 Priority，就會以較高價格換取更好的效能，

cues.en: and if you want to switch back, we switch back to Default.
cues.zh: 如果想切回去，就改成 Default。

cues.en: So, this is how you control it.
cues.zh: 這就是設定方式。

cues.en: If you don't want to put anything in code, you simply switch, and you get a better quality of the service.
cues.zh: 不用修改程式，只要切換設定，就能改變服務品質。

cues.en: And I've seen that, in reality, this is actually quite needed if you have very big requests
cues.zh: 我實際遇過，當單次請求非常大，

cues.en: like several hundred thousand tokens in one go.
cues.zh: 例如一次有幾十萬個 Token 時，Priority 相當有必要。

cues.en: Before we switched in our project to Priority, we simply couldn't use OpenAI for that,
cues.zh: 我們的專案切換成 Priority 之前，OpenAI 幾乎無法處理那種請求，

cues.en: but that might have been a period where they had problems with delivering service.
cues.zh: 不過也可能剛好遇到服務供應比較不穩定的時期。

cues.en: But you can switch. If you want to switch in code, you can also do that,
cues.zh: 總之可以切換；如果想透過程式控制，也做得到，

cues.en: and we do that down in the chat completion options or the response API options, where we have something called Service Tier.
cues.zh: 在 ChatCompletionOptions 或 Responses API 的選項中，有 ServiceTier。

cues.en: And Service Tier can be Auto, meaning it follows what is in the project. It can be Flex.
cues.zh: ServiceTier 可以是 Auto，表示遵循專案設定；也能指定 Flex。

cues.en: If we look at the pricing again, Flex doesn't work on every single model.
cues.zh: 回頭看價格頁面，Flex 並不是每個模型都支援。

cues.en: You can only see it's JGP 5 and 03.
cues.zh: 這裡只看得到 GPT-5 與 o3 等支援的模型。

cues.en: So, some of the earlier models, if you use Flex, it won't work.
cues.zh: 因此較早的模型如果指定 Flex，可能無法使用。

cues.en: While Standard works for everything, and Priority also, more or less, works for everything.
cues.zh: Standard 則全部支援，Priority 也大致適用所有模型。

cues.en: So, we can set that.
cues.zh: 所以可以在這裡指定。

cues.en: We can set default, meaning even if you have a project that is Priority, you can switch it back to default,
cues.zh: 即使專案預設是 Priority，也能在呼叫中指定 Default，

cues.en: or you can have a default project that sometimes, on a case-by-case basis, needs to be Priority.
cues.zh: 或者專案預設是一般模式，但某些呼叫需要改用 Priority。

cues.en: And that's actually everything there is to it, just setting this extra thing.
cues.zh: 整體就是額外設定這個選項，沒有其他複雜步驟。

cues.en: In real life, you would probably just go up in the portal and switch everything to the Premium Service,
cues.zh: 實務上可能直接到入口網站，將整個專案切換成優先服務，

cues.en: or have two projects, one that are Service Tier and one that are Default Tier.
cues.zh: 或建立兩個專案，一個使用 Priority，另一個使用 Default。

cues.en: But that's everything. See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 這次就到這裡，我們下支影片見。
